cards.hint: Think about areas already held by federal forces
options: parts of the Confederacy that had already come under Union control
states that had seceded from the Union
cards.quote: It also expressly exempted parts of the Confederacy that had already come under Union control.
cards.stem: Which areas were singled out as exceptions to the freedom measure

cards.hint: Recall which slaveholding areas stayed loyal
cards.quote: It applied only to states that had seceded from the Union, leaving slavery untouched in the loyal border states.
cards.stem: Where did the measure leave the old labor system still in place

options: kept foreign powers from giving aid
came after a major battlefield win
cards.quote: Most important, the freedom it promised depended upon Union military victory.
cards.stem: What did the promised freedom still need to succeed

cards.hint: The order opened military service to the freed
options: the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy
leaving slavery untouched in loyal areas
cards.quote: Moreover, the Proclamation announced the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy, enabling the liberated to become liberators.
cards.stem: What new service path did the order open for the freed

every card has distinct options after normalisation (options-distinct)
no stem contains its own correct answer (stem-no-answer-leak)
exactly one option per card matches the quote (one-correct)
every number in stems, options and hints appears on the cited page or in the same quote (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
